name: thepapers-niw
description: Skills covering the U.S. EB-2 National Interest Waiver from first question to filed response. Decide whether to pursue it and under what proposed endeavor (niw-evaluate); plan the evidence to gather (niw-evidence-plan); find government sources showing the endeavor advances a national priority (niw-evidence-finder); draft the endeavor statement, the recommendation letters and the petition letter (niw-endeavor-statement, niw-recommendation-letter, niw-petition-letter); review the assembled package before filing (niw-package-review); and answer a Request for Evidence or Notice of Intent to Deny (niw-rfe-response). Legal substance is published in knowledge/ and built on the complete public pool of AAO non-precedent NIW decisions issued 2025-01 through 2026-06. For self-petitioners and immigration professionals. Not legal advice.
